title: Disabling decode: the ordering still holds
summary: Zero the HBM bandwidth term and KV still binds in tokens. Power-of-two-choices still beats round robin, by the same shape of margin.

steps.title: disable_decode: HBM bandwidth to infinity, KV unchanged
body: This scenario zeroes the bandwidth term of the step cost model. Decode no longer costs device time; KV accounting is unchanged, so capacity still binds in tokens.
Per Issao: "we could get disable decode basically by setting HBM to infinity." The point of this run is to isolate routing quality from decode cost.
steps.look_for: Utilization panel showing device time spent on prefill only; decode no longer a cost line.

steps.title: p2c without decode: 97.0% attainment
body: This run is power-of-two-choices routing with decode disabled. Attainment is 97.0%, first-token p99 is 3.8 s, throughput is 18,986 tok/s.
These numbers echo finding 1's p2c figures closely (97.0% attainment, 3,859 ms first-token p99 with decode present), which is the finding: the routing ordering does not depend on decode cost.
steps.look_for: Attainment and first-token p99 in the headline tile.

steps.title: Round robin without decode: 93.7% attainment
body: Open the A/B view with A = p2c (this run) and B = round robin without decode. Round robin's attainment is 93.7%, first-token p99 is 7.2 s, at the same throughput of 18,986 tok/s.
Round robin against p2c: 93.7% vs 97.0% attainment, 7.2 s vs 3.8 s first-token p99, at identical throughput. The ordering holds without decode.
steps.look_for: Throughput overlapping between A and B while attainment and first-token p99 do not.

steps.title: Why this run exists
body: Disabling decode is a way of asking whether the routing-policy story from finding 1 depends on decode competing with prefill for the device. It does not: p2c still wins by roughly the same margin.
That separability is useful for reasoning about prefill/decode disaggregation later — dynamic 14 — where the two costs genuinely live on different pools.
steps.look_for: The KV utilization panel: still binding, even with decode's device cost at zero.
